detail: Edits made in the app sync to the repo, so the plan matches on every device and Claude sees your changes.
Each plan day marks itself Done (or Short) when a ride on that date shows up, with planned vs ridden miles.
One tap moves the long ride to the driest day of the week using the forecast already on Today.
Every Monday, last week's plan vs what you rode, hours in each heart rate zone, and one line of coaching.
Once the SRAM meter is on: FTP, power zones, watts on the plan, and W/kg on the climbs.
The date you'll hit 55 at your current rate of 55+ mi days, with a pace line on the ring.
Your times on Kennesaw and Brasstown Bald turned into a predicted time for the Colombier and the Tourmalet.
Base, build, climb-specific and taper phases from now to July 2027, with where you are today.
Miles on the chain, tyres and brake pads for each bike, with a reminder when something is due.
Week-long trip ideas matched to each bike: flat trail camping on the Bombtrack, fast hotel-to-hotel on the Diverge.
Segments near home where you're close to a Local Legend, ranked by how few efforts you need.
A phone notification the night before a planned long ride if rain is likely.
Long-press the app icon to jump straight to Today, Plan or the weather.
A one-tap image of your week or a big ride, sized for Strava or Instagram.
A PIN so the plan and notes stay private if someone else picks up your phone.
On Dec 31: the 5,000 km wrap-up, best rides, Eddington gain and Local Legends.
